binding.eligibility: step must consume external slot 0 and caller-selected InputPortConsumerSpec must be compatible at bind time
binding.immutability: first successful binding wins; identical rebinding is idempotent and conflicting rebinding fails closed
binding.clear_surface: none; changing semantic meaning requires a new graph builder or graph revision

identity.explicit_non_identity: Burn programIdentity remains based on executable plan bytes and is not changed by semantic edge binding

downstream_semantic_lifecycle.policy: an external lifecycle transition must anchor slot-0 lineage to this persistent edge binding and must reject bind-time provenance drift

drift.policy: drift is reported; binding is never silently rewritten

bindInputPortConsumerEdge.returns: true for first binding, false for identical idempotent binding

inputPortConsumerEdgeBinding.returns: persistent binding plus current drift/compatibility status

semanticGraphIdentity.returns: semantic topology/provenance fingerprint separate from executable programIdentity

invariants: binding never changes AgentGraphBuilder executable plan bytes
binding never mutates AgentWorkspace or LayerRegistry
binding meaning is caller-selected and never inferred from numerical layer type
conflicting rebinding fails without mutating the existing binding
input provenance drift is observable but does not rewrite history
